steps.caption: API keys
steps.narration: API keys and webhooks connect your own tools to the CRM. Both are on Integrations.

steps.caption: Read-only
steps.narration: An API key gives a tool read-only access to your data.

steps.caption: Key name
steps.narration: Give the key a name that says what will use it.

steps.caption: Copy it now
steps.narration: Copy the key now and keep it private. It is never shown again.

steps.caption: Your keys
steps.narration: The list keeps the name and the first few characters. The trash can revokes the key.

steps.caption: Endpoint URL
steps.narration: A webhook tells your own system when something happens. Type its address.

steps.caption: Events
steps.narration: Tick the events you want to hear about. We'll pick estimate approved.

steps.caption: Signing secret
steps.narration: Copy the signing secret now. It is never shown again either.

steps.caption: Active webhook
steps.narration: The webhook is listed as active, with its events.

steps.caption: Menu: Integrations
steps.narration: You'll find both under Integrations in the menu.

youtube.title: How to create an API key and a webhook | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of API keys and webhooks in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will create a read-only API key, then add a webhook that tells your own system when an estimate is approved. The key and the signing secret are each shown once.
